operator_finding: Empirically validates FPGA Round 2 (Deep Think) prescription. Sequential single-site Ising sampler achieves KL(v3 || gibbs) = 0.025 nats vs threshold 0.05 nats — well below the 0.05 detailed-balance acceptance gate. Compare: parallel v1 KL = 3.07 nats (exp1094 confirmed violation) and parallel v1 sim KL = 14.05 nats (even worse on the 8-spin antiferromagnetic ring topology). Tradeoff: sequential is 23x slower per sweep (0.999s vs 0.043s for v1 parallel) at N=8; this is expected and matches FPGA Round 2's prediction that the 13,061x speedup headline must recalibrate downward. Hardware deployment to KV260 board (192.168.51.98, reachable) deferred because Vivado not on PATH — Verilog file shipped at hardware/kv260/ising_sampler_v3_sequential.v (14,422 bytes) for future synthesis. Phase-2 Sparse-Constraint Accelerator architecture from FPGA Round 2 is now empirically grounded at the simulation tier. Ready for the chi<=4 Fast-Path bitstream in .87 once Vivado access is sorted.
title: KV260 Ising Sampler v3 Sequential — Phase-2a Correctness Fix
